51555347.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to TRIP13 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: Trip13 protein was prepared on a CM5 sensor chip. Kinetic measurements were performed with Biacore T2000 (GE Healthcare, 25°C). The compounds were prepared into different concentrations in PBS buffer. Then flowed the solution over the chip, and the combination and dissociation time were recorded respectively and analyzed via T2000 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Results - TRIP13 protein binding and enz: DCZ5416, DCZ5418 and DCZ5436 were chosen to test the binding affinity (Kd) with the TRIP13 through SPR (Surface plasmon resonance). DCZ5418 showed the best binding affinity (Kd = 15.3 μM, Scheme 3A), it could bind TRIP13 better than DCZ0415 (Kd = 57.0 μM). On the other hand, DCZ5436 performed a weak binding activity (Kd = 149 μM) and both the cantharidin and DCZ5416 didn’t show any interactions with the TRIP13 protein (Fig. S1, Supporting information).
